🚨| 𝐎𝐅𝐅𝐈𝐂𝐈𝐀𝐋: Seven Barcelona players have been called up to Spain’s U17 squad for the 2026 FIFA U-17 World Cup. 🇪🇸

• Ebrima Tunkara
• Jordi Pesquer
• Raúl Expósito
• Sergi Mayans
• Baba Kouroma
• Roberto Tomás
• Iu Martínez

The tournament will take place from November 19 to December 13 in Qatar. 🇶🇦
